dp.name: Izinqubomgomo Ezizenzakalelayo
dp.title: Izinqubomgomo Ezizenzakalelayo
dp.lede: Lezi yizinqubomgomo zehhovisi lakho ezizenzakalelayo: okuqala ngazo iphrojekthi entsha nokuthi izinto ezintsha zithola ini. Iphrojekthi osuyiqalile ayishintshi.
dp.app.hint: Inqubomgomo eshiywe njengo "{app}, okwayo" ayishintshi lutho: {app} yenza njengoba bekwenza njalo. Igama lehhovisi nezinqubomgomo zazo zonke izinhlelo zisezilungiselelweni > Okuvamile > Izinqubomgomo Ezizenzakalelayo.
dp.saved: Kugciniwe. Iphrojekthi entsha iqala ngale ndlela.
dp.err.range: Lokho akuphakathi kwalokho lenqubomgomo ivumela ({min} kuya {max}).
dp.err.type: Lena akuyona inani lenqubomgomo le engalithatha.
dp.err.empty: Bhala inani, noma sula ibhokisi ukuze ubuyele kokuzenzakalelayo kohlelo.
dp.group.audit: Ukuhlola: i-LOD esidingwa yisigaba ngasinye sephrojekthi
dp.office.hint: Akudingekile. Ibhalwa kufayela olilondolozayo, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi izinqubomgomo zebani.
dp.count.none: Akukho nqubomgomo esethiwe: wonke amahlelo asebenzisa okwawo okuzenzakalelayo.
dp.file.hint: Londoloza izinqubomgomo njengefayela elincane elivulekile (JSON) ukuze zabelwane ehhovisini lonke; ukulayisha ifayela kuzoshintsha izinqubomgomo kule khompyutha.

dp.reset.all.done: Zonke izinqubomgomo zisethwe kabusha: wonke amahlelo asebenzisa okwawo okuzenzakalelayo.
dp.reset.app.done: Izinqubomgomo zohlelo {app} ziseteshiwe kabusha: lisebenzisa okwalo okuzenzakalelayo.
dp.p.all.system.hint: Lokhu kuyawo wonke amahlelo. Inqubomgomo yamayunithi yohlelo, uma iseyethiwe, iza kuqala.
dp.p.all.anno.text.hint: Amamilimitha ephepheni elinyathelisiwe (ukuphakama kohlamvu olukhulu). Imodeli idwetshwe ngosayizi ogcwele; isakhiwo esisha sithola lezi zakhiwo bese sizigcina kuzo zonke izilinganiso zomdwebo.
dp.p.all.anno.title: Amagama wokubukeka emashidini
dp.p.all.schedule.group.hint: Isetshenziswa yohlu ngalunye olunekholomu enjalo olungabeki ukuhlanganisa kwalo.
dp.o.all.schedule.totals.groups: Inhlamba encane ngaphansi kwalo lonke iqembu nenhlamba jikelele
dp.p.all.schedule.title: Isihloko sohlu
dp.o.all.schedule.headings.title: Ngezinhlamvu Ezinkulu
dp.p.bimcraft.units.hint: Amayunithi ashintsha kulawa uma kudalwa isakhiwo esisha. I-BimCraft ayinazilungiselelo zokunemba, ngakho azikho lapha.
dp.p.bimcraft.levels.name: Amagama wamazinga
dp.p.bimcraft.wall.first.hint: Okudwetshwa yithuluzi Lodonga kuqala esakhiweni esisha.
dp.p.bimcraft.wall.starterLod.hint: Liboniswa noma kuphi lapho kudwetshwa uhlobo lokuqala, kule khompyutha. Uhlobo olwenziwe njengekhophi yolokuqala lugcina ithegi kufayela.
dp.p.bimcraft.audit.lod.concept.hint: Ukuhlola kubika izinto ezingaphansi kwalelizinga lokuthuthukiswa ngalesosigaba. Amanani okuqala e-CadCraft akuwona amazinga ajwayelekile: setha owephrojekthi yakho.
dp.o.bimcraft.sheet.first.sheet: Ishidi lokuqala nepulani yezinga eliphansi kakhulu
dp.p.bimcraft.sheet.title: Igama leshidi
dp.p.cadcraft.length.precision.hint: Izinombolo zamadesimali, 0 kuya 8. Kobude bezakhiwo nezingxenye, kuwumandla amabili engxenye encane kakhulu (4 = 1/16).
